scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:server && concurrently -k "ng serve" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.docker:prod: docker build -t chapterly . && docker run --env-file .env --rm -p 8080:8080 chapterly
scripts.docker:dev: docker build -f Dockerfile.dev -t chapterly-dev . && docker run -v ./chapterly-api-server/data:/app/data -e CHAPTERLY_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERLY_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERLY_STORAGE=chats-idb --env-file .env --rm --name chapterly-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterly-dev
scripts.docker:drun: docker run -v ./chapterly-api-server/data:/app/data -v /dist/chat/browser:/app/public:ro -e CHAPTERLY_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERLY_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERLY_STORAGE=chats-idb --env-file .env --rm --name chapterly-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterly-dev
scripts.docker:local: docker run -v ./chapterly-api-server/data:/app/data -v /dist/chat/browser:/app/public:ro -e CHAPTERLY_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERLY_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERLY_STORAGE=sqlite-all --env-file .env --rm --name chapterly-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterly-dev
